highlights: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki proposes perplexity as a metric to compare model developers and inform shared safety standards, and publishes OpenAI's internal pretraining measurements.
Dragos sent nearly two million canary-laced prompts to AI services and found data from at least three providers exposed, with Zero Data Retention flags often ignored.
On the open-weight side, inclusionAI released the 560B medical model LingSante-3.1-flash and OVHcloud released Olala-v1.0-mini-7A1B, which runs on a laptop.
